# VSL skeleton

Synthetic outline of a video sales letter: hook, problem, mechanism, proof, offer, close. Links [[hook-lab]] and [[boris-ledger]].

## Structure
- **Hook:** one line that stops the viewer, from [[hook-lab]].
- **Problem:** name the pain in the viewer's own words.
- **Mechanism:** the new reason this works, never the full how.
- **Offer and close:** the stack and the risk reversal from [[boris-ledger]].

## Production
- Film face to camera, one take per beat, captions on every line.
